findings.finding: an empty or field-less waiver object ({}) silenced an open HIGH, and a non-string severity failed open; the gate was trivially defeatable and drifted from the repo's sibling waiver validation and the global waiver rule.
findings.resolution: fixed: a waiver clears a HIGH only when it is complete (non-empty reason, approver/approvedBy, and an unexpired parseable expires), else fail closed; non-string severity and non-string resolution fail closed; an expired waiver re-opens the finding. Four new discriminating tests.

findings.finding: the VERIFY rule matched any bare 'verified', flagging domain vocabulary ('email must be verified') and already-grounded claims, and silently changed behavior vs main.
findings.resolution: fixed: VERIFY_CLAIM is scoped to the assertive frame ('I/we verified', 'verified that'), an inline evidence state grounds it, and bare 'verified' was removed from the generic CLAIM pattern. New no-false-positive tests.

findings.finding: the record/scoping-line exemption was line-wide and swallowed a genuine co-located untagged claim (a scoping phrase could smuggle a claim past the linter; a regression vs main).
findings.resolution: fixed: removed the blanket line exemption and narrowed the root false positives instead (generic 'checked' excludes 'not-checked'; 'verified' moved to the dedicated rule), so a co-located claim is caught again. New discriminating tests.
